_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Monthly Maintenance Plan (MMP)
summary: Defines the Monthly Maintenance Plan (MMP) used to identify Organizational level (O-Level) maintenance data in accordance with COMNAVIRFORINST 4790.2C.
use_relationship:
The Monthly Maintenance Plan (MMP) will be used to identify Organizational level (O-Level) maintenance data In Accordance With (IAW) the Commander Naval Air Forces Instruction (COMNAVIRFORINST) 4790.2C.

The Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format is acceptable and must address all requirements listed in section 3 of this DID. The report will be in Microsoft Office 2016 file format (i.e. 2016 Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project) and must be completely accessible (including formulas) to the Government. Forms, letters, and signed documents will be in fully searchable Portable Document Format (.pdf) file. The plan will be free of proprietary markings.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The plan will contain the following:

children.title: Cover Page
children.content: The cover page will contain the following information:

children.title: Title and identification of the system/component/program/project
Date of plan and period covered
Preparing activity and location of the site where prepared
The O-level MMP shall contain the following minimum information
Projected known operational commitments
children.content: including number of flights, flight hours, and aircraft requirements obtained from the Operations Department.

children.title: Schedule of phase or Periodic Maintenance Inspection (PMI) planning meetings
Dates of scheduled receipts or transfers of aircraft and required maintenance actions
Test, Measure, and Diagnostics Equipment (TMDE) calibration requirements
children.content: include lists of TMDE due for calibration and TMDE not yet returned from calibration. MEASURE format 800, if verified as accurate, may be used to determine these requirements, but publication of both TMDE lists shall be included in the MMP.

children.title: Schedule of technical training
children.content: (A separate Monthly Maintenance Training Plan may be prepared and distributed with the MMP as an alternative (paragraph 10.1).

children.title: Forced removal items, such as, high time components
Current list of Quality Assurance (QA) personnel; Quality Assurance Representatives (QARs), Collateral Duty Quality Assurance Representatives (CDQARs), and Collateral Duty Inspectors (CDIs)
List of QA audited programs as well as program managers and monitors
Schedule of personnel due Egress/Explosive Systems Checkout
children.content: The schedule shall include all personnel assigned Temporary Assigned Duty (TAD) to duties outside the command and the date TAD commenced.

children.title: A narrative or visual assessment metric from service unique maintenance personnel
children.content: which demonstrates the organization's ability to perform expected maintenance with the current level of qualified personnel.

children.title: Current designated Ground Maintenance Vehicle Operators (GMVOs) and Unmanned Air Systems (UAS) squadrons only
A listing of all Joint Deficiency Reporting System Deficiency Reporting (JDRS DR) Submitters (Approve and Submit Web site DRs Message Release Authority) and JDRS DR Drafters (draft only)
Report Preparer
children.content: Name of person(s) preparing report, email, and telephone number(s).

children.title: Appendices
children.content: Include appendices where applicable: tables, references, charts, or other descriptive material. Each appendix will be identified and referenced in the appropriate area of this plan.
